text: If you both live abroad, you will move to Israel together. You start by applying through the Israeli Embassy in London, which will review your relationship and give you permission to move here. Once in Israel, you can formally open the process through PIBA. You can read the general overview on our website here, however for specific instructions for the first step, you'll need to contact the embassy (as different embassies can have slightly different requirements  :) https://aic.org.il/the-gradual-process-birds-eye-view/
